name: SF Tools - Metadata Cleanup (Run Last)
description: Removes all test metadata: Deactivates users, deletes permission sets, roles, validation rules, custom fields. Run LAST after testing.
preconditions: User is logged into Salesforce org as System Administrator

steps.description: Deactivate all test users (can't delete users in SF)
Remove permission set assignments before deleting sets
Remove components from permission set group
Remove role assignments from users before deleting roles
Delete roles starting from bottom of hierarchy
Delete validation rule via Tooling API
Deactivate test validation rules (manual deletion required for rules)
Verify all test permission sets were deleted

args.query: SELECT COUNT() FROM PermissionSet WHERE Name LIKE 'Flowstral_Test%'

steps.description: Verify all test roles were deleted

args.query: SELECT COUNT() FROM UserRole WHERE DeveloperName LIKE 'Flowstral_Test%'

steps.description: Verify all test users were deactivated

args.query: SELECT COUNT() FROM User WHERE Username LIKE '%flowstral.test%' AND IsActive = true

notes: Custom fields and validation rules require manual deletion in Setup
Users cannot be deleted in Salesforce, only deactivated
Roles must be deleted bottom-up (children before parents)
